# 보령 "항암약 '보스몰리십' 2상 환자 모집 완료"

기사등록 2026/10/19 10:22:25

  *   * ## 국내 17개 기관서 44명 환자 대상 진행

[서울=뉴시스] 보령은 세계 최초로 혈액암 유발 물질인 PI3K 감마·델타·DNA-PK의 3중 저해 기전을 갖춘 항암신약 후보물질 '보스몰리십'(BR101801)의 임상 2상 환자 모집을 최근 완료했다고 19일 밝혔다. (사진=보령 제공) 2026.10.19. photo@newsis.com

[서울=뉴시스]이소헌 기자 = 보령이 회사가 개발 중인 항암신약의 임상 2상 환자 모집을 완료했다.
보령은 세계 최초로 혈액암 유발 물질인 PI3K 감마·델타·DNA-PK의 3중 저해 기전을 갖춘 항암신약 후보물질 '보스몰리십'(BR101801)의 임상 2상 환자 모집을 최근 완료했다고 19일 밝혔다.
보스몰리십은 암세포의 성장·생존 신호 및 DNA 손상 복구에 관여하는 PI3K 감마, PI3K 델타와 DNA-PK를 동시에 저해하는 퍼스트 인 클래스(First-In-Class) 항암신약물질이다.
성분명인 보스몰리십은 세계보건기구(WHO) 국제일반명(INN)에 등재된 명칭으로, 보령의 앞 글자 'Bo'와 우수한 저분자 화합물, PI3K 저해제 계열에 사용되는 접미사 'lisib'를 결합해 지었다고 회사는 설명했다.
이번 임상 2상은 재발성 또는 불응성 PTCL 환자를 대상으로 보스몰리십 단독요법의 항종양 효과, 안전성, 내약성을 평가하기 위한 단일군·다기관·공개 임상시험이다.
보령은 지난해 5월 식품의약품안전처로부터 2상 임상시험계획(IND)을 승인받았으며, 지난 3월 첫 환자 투약을 시작으로 국내 17개 임상시험 실시기관에서 총 44명의 환자를 대상으로 임상을 진행 중이다.
보령은 첫 환자 투약 이후 약 7개월 동안 목표 환자 44명 모집을 마쳤다. 보령은 향후 1년간의 추적 관찰을 거쳐 오는 2028년 임상 2상을 완료하고 품목허가를 신청할 계획이다.
보령에 따르면 보스몰리십은 미국 식품의약국(FDA)으로부터 PTCL의 하위 질환인 PTCL-NOS와 혈관면역모세포성 T세포 림프종에 대해 희귀의약품 지정을 받았으며, 국내 식품의약품안전처에서도 개발단계 희귀의약품으로 지정됐다.
국내 희귀의약품은 조건부 허가제도를 통해 임상 2상 완료 후 품목허가를 신청할 수 있어, 상용화 시점을 앞당겨 환자들의 치료 접근성을 높이고 새로운 치료 선택지를 보다 신속하게 제공할 수 있을 것으로 전망된다고 회사는 전했다.
김정균 보령 대표는 "말초 T세포 림프종 환자가 선택할 수 있는 치료 옵션이 될 수 있도록 1상에서 확인한 가능성을 2상 결과로 이어가는 한편, 빠르게 환자에게 제공할 수 있도록 향후 임상에 역량을 집중할 것"이라고 말했다.
◎공감언론 뉴시스 honey@newsis.com

  * 카리나, 하루 4㎏ 뺐다…"땀복 입고 뛰고 반신욕"
  * 폭우 속 양복 젖은 채 낙엽 치운 국회의원 반응이…
  * 로이킴 "엄마, 고교 졸업 선물 롤렉스 가서 보자해"
  * 53세 김승수, 39세 아나운서 박혜연과 커플 됐다
  * 권상우·손태영 17살 아들 "키 183㎝, 아빠보다 커"
  * 김장훈 "목숨 끝날 뻔한 경험 많아"

测试候选治疗产品的临床试验通常分为四个阶段，整个开发过程所经历所有阶段通常会耗费数年时间。若药物顺利通过临床试验I、II和III期后，当局监管机构会批准候选产品用于普通患者。临床试验IV期是药物上市后继续研究或药物的持续监测研究，旨在监控药品上市后数年的安全性。

根據現行台灣《動物保護法》第 15 條：使用動物進行科學應用，應儘量避免使用活體動物，有使用之必要時，應以最少數目為之。但實際動物實驗管理層面卻不一定符合法規。

1、兔化豬瘟疫苗

台灣是豬瘟疫區，18 年來已犧牲超過 50 萬隻兔子製作「乾燥兔化豬瘟疫苗」。研究報告指出：目前已有不必犧牲活體動物生產的「組織培養」與「E2次單位」疫苗上市，但至今農委會卻不肯停止生產兔化豬瘟疫苗。不僅未落實3R 原則，更已違反《動物保護法》第 15 條「使用動物進行科學應用，應儘量避免使用活體動物，有使用之必要時，應以最少數目為之」的規定。

Title: Pathology foundation models for training-free case retrieval in salivary gland tumors
Authors: Maximilian J. Roesel, Niklas Kiermeyer, Philipp Keyl, Frederick Klauschen
Date: Thu Oct 15 15:40:48 2026

In pathology, pattern recognition relies on a frame of reference built through extensive training and experience, which may still fall short when encountering rare cancer subtypes. Archives of previously diagnosed tumors often contain relevant precedents, yet identifying the most relevant cases remains challenging. Here we explore whether content-based retrieval with current pathology foundation models facilitates rare cancer diagnostics without any task-specific training. Pathologists can query a digitized archive using a region of interest (ROI) from a whole slide image (WSI) and retrieve morphologically similar cases, along with their ICD-O codes and corresponding WSIs. The ROI can be selected manually or automatically using a gated attention-based multiple instance learning model. We evaluate our approach by leave-one-case-out on an imbalanced dataset of 137 salivary gland tumor cases spanning 12 ICD-O morphology categories, comparing four pathology foundation models (Atlas2, Atlas2-B, Atlas2-S, and UNI2h). Top-1/3/5 retrieval was 62.5%/76.7%/81.3% for Atlas2, 50.2/66.6/72.9% for UNI2h, 52.3%/71.5%/77.6% for Atlas2-B and 54.4/65.2/73.7% for Atlas2-S. Macro-averaged F1 ranged from 69.0% for the smallest model Atlas2-S to 76.6% for the largest model Atlas2 across the five classes with at least ten cases. Our modified Chamfer similarity separated correct from incorrect matches among the Top-5 more reliably for Atlas2 (AUC 0.754) than for Atlas2-B (0.679, p = 0.020) and Atlas2-S (0.653, p = 0.003), but not UNI2h (0.697, p = 0.196). Requiring no additional training or manual annotation, this approach makes departmental archives searchable with pathology foundation models, providing a low-barrier route to case-based differential diagnosis and extending the individual frame of reference to the collective experience of the department.

Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.

With the expansion of pre-trained language model usage in recent years, the importance of datasets for performing tasks in specialized domains has significantly increased. Therefore, we have built a Korean dataset called ESG-Kor to automatically extract Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) information, which has recently gained importance. ESG-Kor is a dataset consisting of a total of 118,946 sentences that extracted information on each ESG component from Korean companies' sustainability reports and manually labeled it according to objective rules provided by ESG evaluation agencies. To verify the effectiveness and applicability of the ESG-Kor dataset, classification performance was confirmed using several Korean pre-trained language models, and significant performance was obtained. Additionally, by extending the ESG classification model to documents of small and medium enterprises and extracting information based on ESG key issues and in-depth analysis, we demonstrated potential and practical use cases in the ESG field.

We adapt the diffeomorphic coarse-to-fine LapIRN architecture for longitudinal whole-body PSMA PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge.
